audience: agents and humans installing multi-agent hotload into a working repo
problem: Multi-agent work needs a shared install surface for roles, leases, and proposals, but without FULL PCM and FULL CGM the install is incomplete and titles/README quality drift.
solution: ACS registers versioned setup modules and ships multi-agent-hotload as the install surface that wires FULL PCM + FULL CGM 0.5.6 + coordination runtime without vendoring those helpers.
mechanism: multi-agent-hotload HOTLOAD.md load order: ACS policy → FULL PCM → FULL CGM → runtime
hotload_check validates assignment pins and runs CGM validate_content_system.py

evidence.claim: multi-agent-hotload pack is registered and documents FULL PCM + FULL CGM pins.
evidence.supports: The pack files and registry entry exist on the task branch and name full-stack pins.
evidence.limits: Does not prove every adopter has run validate yet; CI may be budget-blocked.

boundaries: ACS does not replace PCM or CGM
ACS does not vendor helper source trees
Narrative marketing imagery for ACS root README is deferred
Slim HSW+writing-direction-only pins are incomplete installs
